d:
Di lallantop ka salana adda laut aaya hai. jamega 22, 23 aur 24 navanbar 2024 ko dilli ke mejar dhyan chand neshnal stediyam men. 3 dinon ke lie banie adde ka hissa sirph 499 rupae men. rajistreshan ke lie par die bainar par klik kijie
The Lallantop’s Chunav Yatra has reached Jamtara district. Abhishek Tripathi and Vijay Kumar reached the hub of Cyber Crime and had a word with the localites over these allegations. Congress’s Irfan Ansari and BJP’s Sita Soren are contesting from this seat.
